health.intro: Checks the tariff data for structural errors, gaps, stale or unverified entries and unexpected changes. It never changes prices.
health.manual_queue: {n} tariffs still need manual verification (see FOLLOW-UP.md).
health.rates: Exchange rates: ECB, dated {date} ({age} days ago).
health.reverify_note: A browser cannot read prices from carrier calculators. This only checks whether sources respond; prices are never changed. Tariffs listed below must be verified by hand.
health.sources_note: "Source of truth" = the primary source a tariff takes its price from (highest authority wins). "Supporting" = used only to cross-check. Click a source to open the original.
health.title: Data health
issue.no_primary_source: No source of truth chosen yet
issue.paired_asymmetric: Paired countries have a different number of tariff records
issue.paired_identical_seed: Paired countries have identical seed prices
issue.paired_shared_record: Paired countries share one tariff record
issue.primary_not_best_source: A better source is cited than the one chosen
issue.primary_not_in_sources: Source of truth not in the source list
issue.verified_without_primary: Verified without a source of truth
limits.title: Size and weight limits
opt.cons_assumptions: Assumes the leg carrying the items can take the extra weight and that the items may legally travel together. Weights and sizes of merged shipments are marked provisional.
opt.cons_no_saving: No saving: the merged plan costs {amount} more.
opt.cons_none: No consolidation opportunity found in this plan.
opt.cons_text: Send the items of "{absorbed}" inside "{via}" to the other country, then ship them together with "{merged}". This saves one international shipment.
opt.cons_unknown: Saving cannot be computed because at least one shipment has no usable price.
opt.note: Each strategy picks the best eligible, priced option per shipment. Nothing is applied until you press Apply.
opt.suggest_note: Pick a strategy, then tap Apply. Prices marked unverified stay flagged.
opt.title: Plan optimizer
plan.last_plan_note: The last remaining plan cannot be deleted. Use Settings → Reset to restore the default plan.
plan.leg_off_note: Switched off: not counted in totals, strategies or the sequence. Switch it on to include it again.
plan.leg_toggle: Include this shipment in the plan
plan.now_ineligible: The selected service no longer fits this shipment. Choose another.
plan.price_changed: Price changed since you selected this service.
plan.service_missing: The selected service no longer exists in the data.
plan.unpriced: No usable price for the current settings: this shipment is NOT included in the total.
